title: Advanced Power Cube
keywords: A higher-tier FE buffer and item charger

blocks.text: A higher-tier FE buffer and item charger. It keeps the same distinction between storage, cable throughput and item-charging throughput.

rows: Supply power through a valid input or discharge slot.
Place the target battery or tool in Charge.
Set faces deliberately before attaching mixed EU/J/FE connections.

blocks.text: The external item can impose its own tier, direction, capacity or transfer limit even when the cube has room and power.
